What it does: A checkbox. Whether copies cast shadows. Grass usually doesn't, and turning shadows off for grass saves a lot of work.
The farthest level of detail that casts shadows, from 0 to 3. Levels past it cast none, since shadows of far trees are hardly noticed. 3 lets every level cast them.

A simpler level of detail whose shadow is used for the nearer, detailed levels, from 0 to 3. A detailed tree near the camera is then drawn without its own shadow, and its simpler level is drawn only into the shadow in its place. The shadow looks almost the same and costs much less. 0 lets each level cast its own.
